  • P-01 — Definitions and discrimination

    The Law defines disability, the disability card and discrimination, including distinctions that prejudice rights or equal enjoyment of rights.

    Ouvrir la source — Localisateur consigné: Article 1. Localisateur consigné ; aucun lien profond n'est fabriqué. Ouvrez la source et repérez-le sur place.

  • P-02 — Equality and non-discrimination

    The Law aims to secure rights and services and requires equality and non-discrimination across legislation, policies and development programmes.

    Ouvrir la source — Localisateur consigné: Articles 2-3. Localisateur consigné ; aucun lien profond n'est fabriqué. Ouvrez la source et repérez-le sur place.

  • P-03 — Communication and information rights

    The State is to secure expression and opinion through Braille, sign language and other communication means, and the right to request, receive and transmit information on an equal footing.

Questions d'interprétation ouvertes

Interprétation candidate, non juridiquement révisée.

  • AE-LAW29-01

    Whether Articles 7 and 20 apply to government websites, apps and digital services, or only to the formats and services expressly listed, requires legal review.

    Observation consignée: Article 7 covers expression, Braille, sign language, other communication means and information; Article 20(2) lists electronic texts, sign language, Braille, audio and multimedia.

    Disposition P-03

    État de la preuve: Interprétation candidate; Risque: Élevé; État: Non résolue; Nécessite: Revue juridique qualifiée.

  • AE-LAW29-02

    The implementing Cabinet decision and technical standards contemplated by Article 23 are not captured; their content and current status are unresolved.

    Observation consignée: Article 23 requires the competent authorities to set engineering standards and a Cabinet decision to issue controls and exemptions.

    Disposition P-05

    État de la preuve: Interprétation candidate; Risque: Élevé; État: Non résolue; Nécessite: Capture de la source.

  • AE-LAW29-03

    The relationship between this 2006 Law, Cabinet Resolution 43/2018 and the 2024 National Digital Accessibility Policy needs a consolidated reading.

    Observation consignée: The Law, the 2018 Cabinet Resolution and the 2024 policy address different aspects of disability inclusion and digital accessibility.

    Disposition P-01

    État de la preuve: Interprétation candidate; Risque: Élevé; État: Non résolue; Nécessite: Revue juridique qualifiée.

  • AE-LAW29-04

    The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; Arabic prevails and native legal review is outstanding.

    Observation consignée: The UAE Legislation platform provides an English translation and states that the Arabic text prevails in case of conflict.

    Disposition P-03

    État de la preuve: Interprétation candidate; Risque: Élevé; État: Non résolue; Nécessite: Revue de traduction.
